context.notes: Recorded engineering-study handoff for HiGHS issue 3768. Same original 13-row/364-column MPS and fixed-zero integer; source base 725b40f, Clang 17 Release, one solver thread and 60s limit. A is the instrumented stock CLI; B is the single shared checkColBounds candidate through a C++ public-API probe. Drivers and diagnostic logging differ; rounded native timings are not a speedup benchmark. Keep positive-width intervals live instead of fixing each independently to lower. The complete original-input primal and rational optimum checks are separate: exact optimum 127.1998728. The declared tiny LP remains Infeasible in both builds. Source and complete checks: https://github.com/blucca/blucca.github.io/tree/main/research/highs-positive-width-fix
